prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI marketing agency in Los Angeles depends on your goals, budget, industry, data maturity, and whether you need strategy, creative, or full-stack execution.

To help you find the best fit, tell me a few things:
- Primary goal (customer acquisition, personalization, creative optimization, predictive analytics, CRM automation, ad optimization, etc.)
- Industry (e.g., e‑commerce, B2B SaaS, entertainment, healthcare)
- Budget range (monthly retainer/project size)
- Do you have first‑party data and a marketing stack (CDP, CRM, DSPs)?
- Timeline and geography (LA only or national/global)

How to evaluate/compare agencies (quick checklist)
- Proven case studies and measurable ROI for your goal
- AI capabilities: models used, data integration, personalization engines, model explainability
- Access to talent: data scientists + engineers + creative/marketing strategists
- Tech stack compatibility (CDP, CRM, ad platforms, analytics)
- Privacy/compliance practices (esp. if handling PII)
- Transparency on how AI is used (not just “AI washing”)
- Reporting and A/B testing processes
- References and client retention
- Pricing and expected timelines to value

Types of agencies you’ll find in LA
- Large/global shops with AI practices (R/GA, Merkle, Publicis Sapient, Accenture Interactive, etc.) — good for enterprise scale, integrations, cross‑channel programs.
- Mid‑sized specialist agencies — balance of hands-on attention and technical chops.
- AI‑first/boutique shops — focused on ML, personalization, automation; best if you need deep technical model work and experimentation.

If you want, I can:
- Build a tailored shortlist of LA agencies that match your needs (I’ll need the details above).
- Draft an RFP or interview questions to vet agencies.
- Recommend sample KPIs and contract terms for an AI marketing pilot.

Which option do you want to do next?
